The solution would involve changing file permissions or running the command with appropriate privileges (like sudo), or configuring clickhouse-local to use a different configuration path where the user has write access. This is a configuration/permission issue that can be verified without building any code.

An expert can analyze the error messages and determine that this is a file permission issue without needing to build or run the software. The solution would be to either:
1. Run clickhouse-local with appropriate permissions
2. Change the permissions of the directories in question
3. Configure clickhouse-local to use a different configuration path
